title: Internship in Info Mgmt and Tech (IST 471 M800, Fall 2026)

meeting.source: courses.location + syllabus (no class meetings; fully online, asynchronous internship course)
meeting.note: No lecture pattern. The only scheduled synchronous event is the Assignment 5 midpoint conference, which the student schedules individually.

components.name: Quality of professional work in the internship

rules: Penalties for incomplete, late, or incorrectly formatted assignments are at the professor's discretion.
Failure to receive the site supervisor's evaluation form results in NO CREDIT for the course, regardless of other work.
Minimum 50 work hours per credit hour; 3 credits = 150 hours minimum.
Blackboard point totals (5+5+5+5+10+100 = 130) are bookkeeping for the two weighted buckets, not the grade basis.
grading.source: IST 471 Syllabus.pdf p.5 (hand-placed copy, sha cf69c388...)

tree_shape.description: Three top-level nodes, no weeks and no modules. Content = course documents; Assignments = one Ultra test-link per numbered assignment, each carrying its own attachments in the instructions body; Introductions! = a course link to the single discussion forum. Nothing is dated or sequenced by week; the course is paced by the student's own internship hours.

media_links: Introductions! (course link -> discussion forum, no bytes)

tree_shape.new_file_rule: A new file next week will arrive as a data-bbfile attachment inside an Assignment N test-link's instructions body -> assignment_spec, linked to the matching IST.471/aN assignment. A new file dropped into Content is syllabus_policy only if its title says syllabus/policy; a form (Learning Agreement, evaluation) placed in Content is assignment_spec linked to the assignment that requires it.

gaps.what: Assignment 7 (Final Reflection) has no Blackboard gradebook column and no content item. Re-probed /gradebook/columns and the Assignments folder children on 2026-09-03: still exactly 6 columns (_3599883_1.._3599888_1) and 6 test links. Due date and points remain unknown; assignments row IST.471/a7-final-reflection stays confidence=tentative with due_at null.

Syllabus p.4 (Assignment 6) says the STUDENT evaluation form is under Content alongside the site supervisor form. Content holds only the syllabus PDF, and a full data-bbfile scan of all 11 content items found no student evaluation form anywhere in the shell. Only Site Supervisor Evaluation.pdf exists.
Syllabus p.3 says the Learning Agreement is 'available at this site under Content and under this assignment'. It is only under the assignment. Not blocking — the file was found and catalogued.
site_supervisor name/title/email unknown — required to complete Assignment 1 and Assignment 4, and the person who must email the evaluation that gates course credit.
internship start date and weekly hours unknown, so the 150-hour total, the 30-hour Learning Agreement trigger and the midpoint conference window cannot be placed on a calendar.
midpoint faculty conference (Assignment 5) not yet scheduled; student must initiate by emailing proposed times to pabevans@syr.edu.

Syllabus AI-policy section is the iSchool boilerplate with an unfilled placeholder ('[insert specific assignment, quiz or exam names ...]'), so the operative rule defaults to 'no AI tool permitted unless an assignment says otherwise'. No assignment instruction in this shell mentions AI.
Discussion thread/post contents are not reachable via the v1 API (board detail 403, threads 404). Assignment 2 requires posting to this forum; its content can only be read in the Ultra UI.

notes: Internship course, fully online, no weekly cadence and no lecture materials. The whole corpus is 4 PDFs: one syllabus and three assignment forms. The map's load-bearing finding is that 3 of the 4 files are data-bbfile attachments inside assessment instructions, which the summary crawl does not walk — the same failure mode the IST 352 pilot hit, but here it is 75% of the corpus rather than 1 file of 7.
